scope: North workstream: Astana (Kazakhstan) and Bishkek (Kyrgyzstan), two capital cities from the five-capital Central Asia queue.

cities.name: Astana
cities.targetGeometryEvidence: Official national PKK u_view district 254 returned a valid closed parcel containing the selected point; a 9-cell sample yielded 154 native cadastral keys. Accepted adapter evidence confirms all 154 fresh exact-ID geometry hashes match, 65 small-page requests reproduce the baseline ID set and hashes, an explicit absent ID is absent, and sourceBinding and parcelActBinding each match one parcel. Five measured tiny overlaps were accepted unchanged.
cities.blocker: Esil district 254 and sampled cells only; citywide completeness and kad_nomer permanence/global uniqueness remain unverified. No geometry repair was applied.
cities.nextStep: Keep Esil-only app scope until other Astana districts and citywide coverage have separate evidence.

cities.name: Bishkek
cities.targetGeometryEvidence: No-cookie center query returned land parcels 0889/0890; center is inside 0890. 3x3 sample returned 111 unique parcels; 108 valid, 3 invalid; 12 positive-area overlap pairs.
cities.blocker: Runtime is held for local geometry QA: 3/111 sampled features are invalid and 12 pairs have positive-area intersections. The prototype adapter is implemented but not wired; PROPCODE permanence and citywide scope remain undocumented.
cities.nextStep: Resolve invalid geometry and overlap QA before wiring the public adapter.

overallFinding: Astana has an accepted official national-PKK partial sample in Esil district 254: 154 native cadastral keys across nine cells with fresh exact-ID/hash checks and both binding checks passing. Bishkek has an official anonymous sample of 111 public land-plot polygons, but runtime remains held because the neighborhood contains 3 invalid geometries and 12 positive-area intersection pairs. Neither sample establishes citywide completeness or ownership.
